name: TraceForge
description: Signal paths, via stitching, BGA fanout and live PCB visualization in KiCad PCB Editor
description_full: TraceForge combines signal path timing, trace cleanup, rounded track corners, via stitching, via array placement, RF via fencing, BGA fanout and live net visualization in one PCB Editor panel. Via Tools groups stitching, fencing and arrays. Trace Tools groups cleanup, teardrops and radius-based corner rounding with selective restore. Visualization sets per-group and per-net colors and filters the ratsnest by selected components. It reads the live board through KiCad 10's pcbnew Python bindings. Supports Windows and KiCad 10 only. See the project homepage for documentation and known limits.
